title: apium luteum
intro: Apium luteum, commonly known as wild celery, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of wild celery are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Apium luteum have shown promise in supporting cardiovascular health and may also have anti-cancer properties.
